title: Crypto Payment Gateways for Digital Products: What It Actually Is and How It Works — No Stripe Required
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and digital downloads with automated crypto delivery — no platform middleman, no payout delays, no geographic filter.

content.text: In Nigeria, Kenya, and Zimbabwe, digital creators face a common barrier: payment processors like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or impose severe restrictions. This leaves creators of ebooks, courses, and templates without a reliable way to sell their products online. Crypto payment gateways offer a solution, but how do they work, and can they truly replace traditional platforms? This post breaks down the infrastructure, from automatic payment verification to instant product delivery, and shows how creators can deploy their own sovereign commerce stack without depending on third-party platforms.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

A crypto payment gateway for digital products is a system that enables creators to accept cryptocurrency payments directly from buyers, bypassing traditional financial intermediaries. Unlike Stripe or PayPal, this gateway operates on blockchain networks, ensuring transactions are verified automatically and irreversibly. For creators in regions with restricted access to conventional payment processors, this infrastructure provides financial sovereignty. It’s not a workaround—it’s a base-layer solution that gives creators full control over their sales process, from payment to product delivery, without platform fees or geographic restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The core architecture consists of four components: hosting, backend logic, order storage, and payment verification. Hosting platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve the storefront. Backend logic, handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, automates product delivery upon payment confirmation. Order data is stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, while payment verification is managed by NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. When a buyer sends crypto, NOWPayments triggers a webhook that fires the delivery script, ensuring instant and secure fulfillment without manual intervention.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software in regions where traditional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. It’s for those who want to own their commerce stack outright, not rent it. Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines are prime candidates. By deploying this stack, they gain infrastructure sovereignty, eliminating dependence on platforms that can restrict or shut down their business at any time.
Crypto payment gateways eliminate platform fees and geographic restrictions, giving creators financial sovereignty.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component plays a critical role: Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages provide free, reliable hosting. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic for automated delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments and triggers delivery via webhook. File storage is handled by Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring fast and cost-effective product delivery. Together, these tools form a cohesive stack that operates independently of any single platform, giving creators full ownership and control over their sales process.

To deploy this infrastructure, start by choosing a hosting platform and setting up your storefront.
